title: Initiative health fusion: weighted SLI pulse for gated rollouts
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Teams currently track SLIs at route- and service-level, but we lack a standardized, auditable view that rolls those SLIs up into an initiative-level health score that directly drives rollout gates and error-budget allocations. This makes it hard for PMs and oncall to decide when to throttle new features, when to pause canaries, and how much error budget to assign to exploratory experiments.

Goal: Build an Initiative Health Fusion (IHF) capability in the Console + Reliability Hub that: (1) consumes per-route/service SLIs and traffic signals, (2) computes a weighted health score per initiative that factors SLI importance and customer impact, (3) exposes thresholds for automated gating (canary pause/rollback, throttle bursts, reduced traffic), and (4) surfaces drift and attribution for post-mortems and quarterly OKRs.

Success criteria: initiative health score present for 80% of reliability initiatives in the next quarter; automated gate action executed for simulated canary where health score crosses thresholds in >95% of test runs; PMs can view contributing SLIs and their weights and simulate impact in Console.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Console shows initiative-level health score (0-100) for a selected initiative with last 30d trend.
2) Each initiative references 1..n SLIs with editable weights and customer-impact tags.
3) Policy engine supports three gate actions: PAUSE_CANARY, REDUCE_TRAFFIC_BY_PERCENT, TRIGGER_ROLLBACK with configurable thresholds.
4) Gate decisions logged and linked to error-budget usage with an audit trail.
5) Integration tests against synthetic SLI streams demonstrate deterministic gate behavior.
6) Documentation (Confluence) describing formula, weight guidance, and runbook for responding to gates.

2026-03-02: Kickoff with Reliability PMs and Observability Eng. Agreed to prototype using existing SLI streams from telemetry pipeline; use traffic-weighting + customer-impact multiplier.
2026-03-04: Design session — UX sketch for Console panel (initiative header, health score, contributing SLIs, simulated toggle). Design owner DES-332 assigned to produce mock.
2026-03-06: Scoped policy engine prototype: rule format proposed: {metric_id, weight, operator, threshold, action, cool_down_minutes}. Need to formalize schema for policies and persistency.
2026-03-08: Engineering raised a blocker: runtime exposes aggregated per-route KV only at 1m resolution; policy wants 10s for canary gating. Decision: add short-window aggregator at ingestion edge for canaries (ENG-71890).
2026-03-09: Draft Confluence spec uploaded: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/initiative-health-fusion (link points to spec). Added GH PR for proto policy engine: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/12456.
2026-03-10: PM review — request to include explicit customer-impact taxonomy (tier 0 / tier 1 / tier 2 endpoints) and to provide examples mapping to error-budget tranches.
decisions:
1) Health score formula: weighted geometric mean across normalized SLI scores, multiplied by traffic share and customer-impact multiplier (example mapping: tier0=1.25, tier1=1.0, tier2=0.8).
2) Threshold bands: Green >= 90, Yellow 75-89, Red < 75. Automated actions: Yellow = reduce new traffic by 25% for 10m, Red = pause canary and notify oncall + trigger rollback window.
3) Persist policy definitions in existing Console config store (no new infra).
4) Simulate gates in staging using synthetic SLI replay before any production automation (safety-first).
